name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: SIGN-CHECKBOX-TRIGGER BUILD, not for production: trunk's production Sqlite.sys.mjs-based cleanup logic, unchanged, but triggered by toggling the Security > "Digitally Sign This Message" checkbox in the compose window, hooked directly via monkey-patching the compose window's own toggleGlobalSignMessage() from the privileged Experiment side (not a WebExtension event). Known caveat: never fires if the identity always signs by default (checkbox starts checked, never toggled), and firing order relative to Thunderbird's own recipient-cert resolution is not guaranteed the way compose-window-open's is.
